definitions.terms: In every test a character is one UTF-16 unit of the JavaScript string (every route here holds only characters of 16 bits). The text is the whole route text as it stands, the field route of a line of the by-source JSONL, what the checker gives the classifier, and never the field def. Nothing is trimmed. A letter is any character the JavaScript test \p{L} with the u flag matches, in any script; a lowercase letter is one \p{Ll} matches. The character before the mark is the one at the mark's index less one, the character after it the one at the mark's index plus one. No test uses a word list, the words begins with or contains, the container, or the start or the end of the text.
definitions.first_match: For each mark the shapes are tried in the order they stand in this file; the first whose test holds names the occurrence. This dictionary's routes hold one mark, the hyphen, and one shape, so every occurrence takes it.

shapes.means: unverified: joins the parts of one compound proper name that the source's English gloss writes as one word («Tiglath-Pileser», «Abel-beth-maacah», «Merib-Baal»), so that the whole name is one reading and the hyphen never cuts it; every hyphen here stands between two letters with no space on either side, 36 of 41 before a capital letter and 5 before a lowercase one (axis: occurrences).
shapes.test: The mark is the hyphen; every hyphen takes this shape, with no further condition, since it is the only shape of its mark (terms, first_match). Counted by this ledger and not a condition of the test: the character before it and the character after it are letters.

homonyms.reason: The route text is the English gloss of one lexeme of the source and carries no entry number; the source's own lexeme (its vocalized lexeme in tf__2021__voc_lex_utf8.tf) stands in the store's record and not in the route. One letters key carries two texts (עבד נגו): the same key written with two glosses, so this count holds senses and homonyms together and the route text tells them apart under none.

not_done_here: This ledger leaves to the span store every route that holds no mark (111 of 149 routes, axis: routes), among them the names the source writes as two words with a space (97 routes hold a space, axis: routes), because a shape stands only at a mark; nothing is struck and no route is divided.
